verdict.rationale: Metronome documents a public REST API with bearer-token authentication, pagination, idempotency, endpoints for contracts, billable metrics and subscriptions, and official SDKs in five languages. A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, which makes the API machine-discoverable for AI-native use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Metronome’s API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests.
Use the Metronome API to manage your customer's subscription lifecycle including pricing changes, free trials, upgrades, and downgrades.
The SDKs for Python, Go, Ruby, Node.js, and Java offer developers flexible options for implementing Metronome's capabilities across platforms and environments.
Metronome provides built-in idempotency mechanisms so you can safely retry requests without introducing extraneous data.
